hunks.sol: The four walls surrounding the city now ran a full ten ri in length, enclosing a vast area behind fortifications whose strength was rarely seen even in the Central Plains.

hunks.sol: Would it look like this if dozens—hundreds—of sunsets overlapped?

hunks.sol: In the slowing world, countless eyes widened at a sight none of them could describe.

hunks.baseline: The soldiers on a dozen or more watchtowers, beating their assigned war drums and waving their flags with all their strength.
hunks.sol: The soldiers atop a dozen or more watchtowers, beating their assigned drums and waving their flags with all their strength.

hunks.sol: And the moment they all felt a chill climb their spines—

hunks.baseline: “Danger—!”
hunks.sol: “Watch out—!”

hunks.sol: The wind swallowed the shout and tore across the city.

hunks.sol: Dust, shattered rock, even blades that had lost their owners flew through the air. Everyone ducked and threw themselves toward cover.

hunks.baseline: Flames burst from a forcefully thrust punch, devouring the space around him.
hunks.sol: He drove out a fist, and flames burst forth, devouring the space before him.

hunks.sol: And if the blast had reached the North Gate, more than two hundred jang away, what state must the West Gate—the source of it all—be in?
